purpose: Balanced development experiment before the final paper evaluation
sampling: Existing cleaned TRSAv1 loader, 400 per class, followed by seed-42 shuffle; labels unchanged
execution: Shared immutable morphology and parsing; independent decision composition for the four conditions
timing: HisNet includes morphology, dependency times are composition only, shared parse time is recorded separately
verification_selection: First review of each gold class, four independent full pipelines; 12 comparisons after completion
corrections: Candidate resolver is kept outside src until the baseline and independent verification complete
